quote.text: no man is free until he s a master of himself!!
quote.author: epictitus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Embrace self-mastery to serve as a role model for your children; when you control your impulses and emotions, you demonstrate the value of discipline and integrity.
    • Guide your children on the path to freedom by nurturing in them the understanding that inner control is the foundation of true independence.
  • Leadership
    • Recognize that genuine leadership begins with the mastery of oneself; when leaders are disciplined and reflective, they inspire trust and respect in their teams.
    • Apply self-control to navigate difficult decisions; a leader who is secure in their inner strength can calmly guide others through adversity with wisdom and fairness.
  • Product Management
    • Exercise self-mastery to maintain clarity amidst complexity; being reflective and disciplined allows you to focus on what truly matters for the product's success.
    • Harness inner control to adapt to rapidly changing scenarios; when you are the master of your reactions, you can foster innovation and resilience within your team.
